title: Editing a file updates what the dev server serves
intent: The closed loop every developer expects: write a file, see the result. It requires fs.watch or an equivalent notification path, which the incumbent shipped late, so it is the most likely honest failure in the lane.
source: stackblitz-conformance: Vite (hot module replacement) (public 'Runtime Test Cases for AI Agents' suite, adapted into our own scenario)

steps.purpose: Rewrite a source file while the server is running

knownLimits: Depends on a file-change notification path. Charter Q5 places fs.watch outside Phase 1, so a failure here is scope, not regression, and must be recorded as such.
